name: Plaguewood Tower
summary: Plaguewood Tower watches over the northern trails near Terrordale, its stones broken. Lordaeron kept a watchpost here until the Scourge invasion brought it to ruin.

sections.title: A Ruined Sentinel in the North
sections.body:
Plaguewood Tower's fractured stones overlook the northern trails between the Plaguewood and blighted Terrordale. The Kingdom of Lordaeron kept this post to guard the region.

When the Scourge swept across the land, the tower was battered into ruins among corrupted fungal canopies. Its broken walls still face the trails, the last remnant of Lordaeron's watch here.

faq.q: What was Plaguewood Tower originally used for?
faq.answer: The Kingdom of Lordaeron built Plaguewood Tower as a regional watchtower. Before the Third War, guards watched the northern forests, roads and settlements such as Terrordale from here. The Scourge overwhelmed and shattered the garrison.

faq.q: Where exactly is the tower located?
faq.answer: Plaguewood Tower stands in the northern Eastern Plaguelands, within the Plaguewood, just outside ruined Terrordale and south of Stratholme's outer blighted reaches.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Lordaeron's shattered watchtowers recall the human lands lost to the Scourge.
For the Horde, ruined fortifications like Plaguewood Tower show how thoroughly the Scourge broke the northern kingdoms' defenses.
